questions.q: What work did every prophet do according to the hadith?
questions.explain: No prophet was sent except that he tended sheep.

questions.q: Where did the Prophet SAW say he used to tend sheep?
questions.explain: He said he tended sheep at Ajyad, an area still known today.

questions.q: Why did the Prophet SAW work as a shepherd?
options: Because there was no other work in Makkah
Because he wanted to become rich
To help Abu Talib, who was struggling and poor
questions.explain: He earned a living by his own hard work because Abu Talib's family was struggling.

options: A shepherd, one responsible for his flock
questions.explain: This includes leaders and heads of families.

options: One who is responsible and will be questioned
questions.explain: Mas'ul is not a term of privilege, but a responsibility that will be questioned.

questions.q: What did the dirty work of tending sheep cultivate?
questions.explain: This compassion made his followers love him.

questions.q: What is said about the circadian rhythm and the sunnah?
options: Prayer times and early sleep match the body's biological clock
questions.explain: Align life with the cycle of the sun.

questions.q: A shepherd's gentleness means he is weak.
questions.explain: False. He must be brave alone and strong, yet gentle.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW was trained from childhood to earn a living by his own hard work with no dependency mindset.
questions.explain: True. Work and do not depend on handouts.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Reflecting deeply on the meaning behind words
Living with only what is essential
One responsible who will be questioned

questions.explain: Uzlah is withdrawing, tadabbur is deep reflection, minimalism is living with the essential, and mas'ul is the one responsible.

questions.q: Each of us is a shepherd who will be questioned. What is the right attitude to our responsibility?
options: Realise our responsibility and begin with ourselves
questions.explain: Leadership is a responsibility we will be questioned about.
